runs.text: Forty nine thousand Jews. One airlift. nineteen forty nine. Yemen. A Jewish community that had lived here for many centuries. When Yemen's ruler lets most of them leave, whole families walk to Aden, the British port. Many arrive sick and exhausted. Then the planes come. American crews, from Alaska Airlines. They rip out the seats. A plane built for forty eight now carries over a hundred people. The operation's name comes from the Bible: On Wings of Eagles. Flight after flight, up the Red Sea, to Israel. By September nineteen fifty: about forty nine thousand people. The landing was hard too. In twenty twenty one, Israel's government said it regrets the children who vanished from immigrant families in those years, and approved compensation. Did you know this story? Tell me below. That's the story behind one number.
